D1.statement: Among feeds with a lapse-census row and a holiday check, feeds with at least one past lapse have a holiday flag more often than feeds with none (one-sided Fisher exact test, p < 0.05).

D2.statement: Among feeds with a holiday check and an English check, feeds whose English check is flagged have a holiday flag more often than feeds whose English check is ok (one-sided Fisher exact test, p < 0.05).
